subject: Re: Review complete Stage37 cohort
body:
Stage37 final cohort review complete. Every figure you reported reproduces exactly from raw per-arm data, all six gates pass, and all provenance verifies. Recommendation: BOUNDED ACCEPTANCE, with one principal caveat that belongs in the archive and in any publication wording. Source-only; I ran no builds, tests, harness or summarizer, and mutated nothing under /tmp/enola-alias-observation.

1. GOVERNING TEXT AND PINS. I validated against final/PROMOTION_RULE.md, sha256 f1a4bbcefeeb4eac67c9df4ea8bfc3f8845bffcb1a65065c79e9d62069a75e74, which is the pinned copy. All 23 files in final/cli-pairs/pins.json verify byte-for-byte, zero problems, and all three binary pins verify: baseline and control both f69bae0951bffec1 (published Stage36 7812838), candidate 15f5589549dbebb0 (550e1fa, clean checkout 02df91a). Product fba38bab93c76a4da8df58cf45fd6847a468c315. The three history receipts verify at their recorded hashes (3, 14, 1453 delta parses) and full-suite.log hashes to the receipt value 9dba7767. harness-relocation-validation.json is accurate: every executable and scope file is byte-identical across the /tmp to /private/tmp relocation, and PROMOTION_RULE.md is the only differing file, by the one appended supersession paragraph.

2. WINDOW. Granted 17:10:00 to 17:55:00 UTC, 45 minutes; all twelve arms ran 17:14:48.202826 to 17:30:35.069110 UTC, 15.8 minutes, non-overlapping and in order. I specifically checked whether the at-least-60-minute planning clause applied: it does not. That clause was in the Stage36 appended section; this rule requires only one explicitly acknowledged quiet interval with no minimum length. So the 45-minute window is compliant, not a deviation.

3. ARITHMETIC, recomputed from the twelve metrics.json files rather than read off timing-comparison.json. All 28 scenario medians are the mean of sorted ranks 3 and 4 and match to the last digit. Ratio of medians throughout, not median of ratios. noop 2.085532291 to 2.025773625 s, ratio 0.971346084287, -2.865392%. initial -0.055425%, body -0.631448%, structural -2.148681%. mean_scenario_median_ratio 0.985747635981746. Sum of the four medians 21.566547916562 to 21.383480562421 s, -0.183067354141 s, -0.848849%. All 24 paired percent changes reproduce exactly under repeat-index pairing.

4. SIX GATES, with margins on record.
a. Primary noop ratio 0.971346 at or below 0.98: PASS. The candidate needed 2.043821646 s and delivered 2.025773625 s, 18.05 ms of headroom, 0.865 pp.
b. All six paired noop ratios below 1: PASS, and comfortably: 0.976007, 0.997435, 0.940357, 0.932528, 0.972026, 0.967884, that is -50.0, -5.2, -127.9, -146.3, -58.4, -66.1 ms. Worst pair 2 keeps 5.2 ms. noop is the only scenario whose baseline and candidate ranges do not overlap: 2.042627 to 2.167941 against 1.992064 to 2.037388.
c. initial/body/structural median regressions at most 2 percent: PASS, and all three are improvements, so the gate is not close.
d. Every scenario median RSS increase at most 5 percent: PASS at initial +2.104421, noop -1.082481, body +3.471707, structural +1.627841. The three cold labels also improve, -2.97, -0.48, -0.35 percent, which matters because the summarizer applies the RSS and the 2 percent time checks only to the four measured scenarios, not to the cold labels; here the distinction is immaterial since the cold labels improve.
e. Mean scenario median ratio below 1: PASS at 0.985748.
f. Sum of scenario medians nonincreasing: PASS at -183.1 ms. Decomposition: initial -6.3, noop -59.8, body -24.1, structural -92.9 ms. Unlike Stage35 no scenario has to pay for another; every term is negative.
Jackknife on the primary, as robustness only and not as a gate variant: leave-one-pair-out gives -3.190808 (drop 1 or 2), -2.539111 (drop 3 or 4), -2.933562 (drop 5), -2.797402 percent. Every leave-one-out still clears 0.98.

5. COUNTERBALANCING. Realized order B1 C1 C2 B2 B3 C3 C4 B4 B5 C5 C6 B6, that is AB BA AB BA AB BA, three of each, which is also what the summarizer requires positionally. The Stage35 position effect largely did not recur: noop AB group mean -3.7203 against BA -3.4051 percent, a 0.315 pp gap, against 1.575 pp at Stage35. Counterbalancing is doing much less work here, which strengthens the six-of-six result.

6. CORRECTNESS, recomputed rather than trusted. Exactly one distinct graph hash per label across all twelve arms, 194f7fbf for initial/noop/body/cold-original/cold-body and 777ca168 for structural/cold-structural, with wire.normalized_hash equal to graph_hash wherever published. Within-arm incremental equals cold for initial, body and structural: zero mismatches in 36 comparisons. All twelve no-ops: noop_state_before equals noop_state_after, zero wire messages, ParsedFiles 0, generation 1 to 1, OwnersPublished 0, EarlyLocal 0, and Stats files_read 0, files_parsed 0, cached_files 6801, summary_scans 0, derived_indexes 0, discovery_passes 0, identical in both arms. Broker completeness_status success and batch_count_matches_end true on all 72 published-label observations, correctly absent on noop. Every publication-content wire field is identical across all twelve arms: normalized_hash, node and edge records, graph totals and deltas, owner_scope_count, schema_version, scope_mode, generation_kind, messages_observed, batches_observed and the completeness counts. All twelve exits 0, validation_error null, run_succeeded and all_checks_validated true, correctness_only false, competing_samples 0. Twelve arms, no thirteenth directory, no refill. cli-cross-arm-validation.json checks out: seven calls each arm, same Product, all seven graph hashes equal.
payload_bytes_total is the only wire delta and it is fully explained with zero unexplained bytes: candidate run identifiers are 59 characters against the baseline's 58, giving initial and each cold label exactly +3084 equal to 3081 batches times one byte plus 2 on begin plus 1 on end, body +3 equal to 0 plus 2 plus 1, structural +4 equal to 1 plus 2 plus 1. Harness naming artifact, not candidate behavior. Worth one archive line so it is never later read as a publication-content change.

7. HOST EVIDENCE, recomputed from the raw jsonl and vm_stat text. Pressure: 3606 samples across twelve files, every one Darwin dispatch level 1, maximum gap 0.2799 s, no error rows, so the 250 ms cadence held everywhere and nothing approached the one-second rejection threshold. Per-sample wall-minus-monotonic offset spread 2.081 ms across the cohort, so no suspension anywhere; I am reporting that per-sample figure and not the series-level drift, which is 2148 to 2261 ms and is an instrumentation constant of run-timing-series.py, consistent with the accepted cohorts. Swapouts constant at 3042366 across all 24 observations, zero new in every arm; Swapins rise monotonically with no resets, context only. Power: 24 of 24 observations AC Power, lowpowermode 0, charge 57 down to 48 percent, every observation at or above the 20 percent floor and each pair bracketing its own arm's monotonic interval. I validated these by importing your power_gate.validate rather than re-implementing the parse. caffeinate appears in 371 of 371 whole-host samples; as before, the sampler omits arguments so the -i flag specifically is not verifiable from receipts, only that caffeinate ran throughout. Host audit 30 to 32 samples per arm, no errors. I am not treating boundary power as proof of uninterrupted AC within an arm, consistent with the rule's own wording.

8. SUMMARIZER AND GATE PROVENANCE, audited by reading rather than running. background_gate.py, memory_gate.py, power_gate.py and timing_gate.py are byte-identical to both the Stage35 and Stage36 accepted copies. summarize-timing.py here, 30360fd59ef2c10e, is byte-identical to the Stage35 accepted copy and differs from the Stage36 copy only in the primary block: primary is comparison['noop'] with threshold median_percent_change at most -2, which is exactly the frozen rule's ratio at most 0.98, and the gain also requires all six paired changes below zero. So the summarizer was not re-authored for this cohort; it was reverted to the already-accepted Stage35 form that matches this rule. It is fail-closed in the ways that matter: timing-series hold must equal timing-window.json exactly, the arm order is checked positionally, arms must be non-overlapping and inside the window with exit 0 and no recorded error, memory and power evidence are recomputed and compared to what the runner recorded with a raise on mismatch, the validator is hash-pinned before it is exec'd, cross-arm graph hash equality is enforced over all twelve arms and seven labels, and binary pins are format-checked and compared per arm. memory_gate independently enforces zero new Swapouts and rejects counter resets. timing_gate.validate_hold in current-roster mode authenticates each participant against its own evidence file: message id and from_handle must match that participant's handle, the acknowledgment must be same-day, and both interval strings must appear in that participant's own body, with the codata terminal participant checked by quote against its own terminal tail.
One caveat I must restate precisely because it looks stronger than it is: pair-receipt.json records a single quiet_ack_message_id and in all twelve arms it is mine, msg_7bb9e6e7f5fa, and the summarizer only checks that it equals hold['worker_message']. That is a self-consistency check, not the window authorization. The authorization is the four-participant roster in timing-window.json validated per participant by timing_gate. I did not and cannot speak for the other three.

9. TRACED NO-OP ATTRIBUTION. This is the new evidence and it answers the question I left open, so thank you for capturing the baseline profile. Both profiles are clean and comparable: same cloned state from correctness-candidate-1/cold-original, same argv except binary and state-dir, ENOLA_GRAPH_PROFILE=1 both, exit 0, state and broker info unchanged, correct binary sha in each receipt.
ts_disc_alias_roots is 0.073 s baseline against 0.016 s candidate, so the mark the change targets shrinks by about 57 ms, and its parent ts_discovery_build goes 0.185 to 0.136 s, about 49 ms. That magnitude is coherent with the cohort's 59.8 ms noop median gap and with the rule's stated approximately 52 ms component opportunity.
Two honest limits on that pair of traces. First, side_reads 2004, stat_reads 2016, walked_dirs 668 and captured 59 are identical in both traces, so those counters do not register the avoided alias enumeration at all; the saving is visible only in the timing mark, and the counters must not be cited as corroboration. Second, and more important, these are single instrumented runs: unrelated marks move by comparable or larger amounts in both directions, engine_hash_files -101 ms, detect_asyncapi +41 ms, graphinput_build +35 ms, and the candidate's cli_complete total is actually 10 ms HIGHER, 2.257 against 2.247 s. So the trace pair localizes the mechanism to one labelled phase; it does not and cannot corroborate the cohort effect. The cohort is the measurement; the trace is the localization.

10. PRINCIPAL CAVEAT, foreign host load is imbalanced in the candidate's favour. Summing the listed foreign process CPU in each arm's whole-host samples, which is a lower bound on foreign load and the same measure I used at Stage35, per-arm means are baseline 193.40, 99.33, 222.38, 251.55, 177.99, 96.26 percent against candidate 185.29, 101.60, 203.54, 229.34, 168.88, 96.17. Baseline mean 173.49, candidate 164.14, a 9.35 pp direction favouring the candidate in five of six pairs. At Stage35 the comparable figure was 0.77 pp, so this host session was both far busier and materially less balanced. Top foreign consumers were siriactionsd at 66 to 118 percent, WindowServer around 27, then mobileassetd, BackgroundShortcutRunner, com.apple.Virtualization.VirtualMachine, ClearVPN, codex and Orca. Across pairs the per-pair load delta and the per-pair noop result track each other closely: Pearson 0.9109, Spearman 0.8286.
I then tried to bound how much of the margin that could explain, and the answer is reassuring but not free.
- Regressing each arm's own noop seconds on its own foreign load gives a directly measured sensitivity of 0.714 ms per pp for the baseline arms and 0.0730 ms per pp for the candidate arms, 0.5008 pooled over all twelve.
- Removing the candidate's own-arm load advantage at the baseline-measured slope gives an adjusted median ratio of 0.976285, -2.3715 percent. At the pooled slope, 0.975108, -2.4892 percent. Both still clear 0.98. So on the cohort's own measured load sensitivity the primary gate survives the confound with roughly 0.4 to 0.5 pp to spare.
- I deliberately did not use the naive regression of paired result on paired load delta, whose zero-load-delta intercept is -1.469 percent and would fall short of the line, because its implied sensitivity is 4.67 ms per pp, 6.5 times the directly measured baseline figure. At n equals 6 that slope is not credible as a causal load coefficient; it is fitting noise. I am flagging it only so that nobody derives it later and reads it as a failure.
- Counter-evidence that this is not purely confound. Baseline noop tracks its own arm's load strongly, r equals 0.9311, while candidate noop is nearly flat against its own load, r equals 0.2422, and candidate dispersion is far tighter, 45.3 ms spread and 16.4 ms stdev against the baseline's 125.3 and 48.9 ms. That is what less contention-sensitive filesystem work should look like. The two lowest-confound pairs still favour the candidate: pair 6 at only -0.09 pp load delta returns -3.2116 percent, and pair 2, where the candidate had MORE load, still wins by 5.2 ms. One honest qualification on the mechanistic reading: the candidate's flatness is specific to noop. For initial, body and structural the candidate correlates with its own load as strongly as or more strongly than the baseline, 0.838, 0.737, 0.924. That is consistent with the mechanism acting on the no-op path only, which is where it should act, but it means flatness is not a general property of the binary and rests on six points.
- Labelled sensitivity, explicitly NOT a gate computation, NOT a subset selection and NOT a request for one: dropping the two most load-advantaged pairs would give -1.889807 percent over four pairs. I report this only because it is the honest size of the exposure. Your instruction was to check all samples with no subset selection and not to weaken a frozen gate after timing, and I agree with both. The six-pair figures stand as computed and as the rule defines them.
Constructive point rather than a complaint: your own harness already implements the screen for exactly this. summarize-timing.py lines 121 to 141 apply background_gate rates, violations, check_processes and compare_background against a preregistered matching band, but only when hold mode is controlled-background. This cohort ran in current-roster mode, which the frozen rule permits, so that comparison was inactive by design. If a future cohort is intended to support a stronger attribution claim than this one, controlled-background is the mode that would close this caveat, and no new code appears to be needed.

11. ARCHIVE HYGIENE, none of these a gate failure.
a. final/cli-pairs/pins.json still carries purpose "prospective Stage37 whole CLI validation; no acceptance yet", now stale; same item as Stage35.
b. The outer /tmp/enola-alias-observation/cli-pairs/pins.json still pins candidate 042a0c6e, the superseded fca10d8 prototype. Worth marking superseded so it cannot later read as the pinned acceptance binary. Repeating my earlier suggestion only because the archive is about to be published.
c. full-suite-receipt.json is better than Stage35's on this point but still bounded: it records exit 0, 110 packages passed and explicitly 99 cached with the 11 uncached packages and their durations listed, no -count=1 and no wall timestamps. The uncached set is cachecov, docslint, engine, messagingcoverage, tsextractor, facts, graphsession, intent, server, bootstrap and command, which is consistent with only tsextractor changing and its dependents re-executing, and graphsession at 512 s plus engine at 46 s plus tsextractor at 40 s are real executions. So I do not think a rerun is warranted; I would just record that the receipt states its own cache accounting rather than excluding caching.
d. VALIDATION-STATE.json still lists its pending items as pending although all of them are now discharged, and records the first history attempt's /tmp symlink failure, which is good practice to keep.
e. initial's median of -0.055425 percent is not robust at this spread, paired values from -3.1906 to +1.0060, so it licenses neither an improvement nor a regression claim for initial. body at -0.631448 is similar, one pair at +2.0007. Only noop and structural have consistent signs.

12. CLAIM BOUNDARIES for publication, restating the rule's own closing language so nothing overreaches. This supports: on this host, this Product tree and these six counterbalanced pairs, the guarded alias-observation candidate reduces fresh-process no-op median wall time by about 2.87 percent with all six pairs favouring it and non-overlapping ranges, does not regress the other three scenarios or RSS, and reduces the sum of scenario medians. It does not support: statistical significance, near-zero fresh no-op, completion of the broader startup or delta goal, resident-watch latency, old-upstream comparison, complete current-main historical coverage, or a clean attribution of the full 2.87 percent to the mechanism alone given item 10. Absolute seconds from this cohort must not be compared against Stage32, Stage35 or Stage36, because per-arm host speed has varied about threefold across sessions and remains unexplained; every gate here is a ratio or within-cohort comparison for that reason.

13. VERDICT. No blockers. engineering_accepted true is supported: I reproduce all six gate conditions independently from raw data, provenance and pins verify completely, correctness is clean on every arm, and the host gates pass on the raw evidence. I recommend bounded acceptance and publication with the item 10 caveat written into the archive alongside the result, worded as an attribution and durability caveat rather than a gate question, and with item 12 as the claim boundary. The single most useful change for the next cohort that wants a stronger claim is running in controlled-background mode so the preregistered load-matching band is active.

Nothing under /tmp/enola-alias-observation was modified; I read only, ran no builds, tests, harness or summarizer, and touched no candidate state. Standing offer continues: I will verify any future cohort's computed summary gate by gate against the frozen text, including the conditions that pass, source-only and without host access. Idle and source-only until your next request.
